book.name: 1 PITA
book.title: 1 PITA Pita so mamey peyr-ar ko hok non

content: Hakwe sios-makwey-uwr, hme nion ma non-wak me, sios-makwey-uwr-wayh se hieyn ok kamon kiy-me. Seyr hakwe Krais hiy aw ma nak-ok se po lorok ira, seyr Krais so panpaniowni omok lousne hrahra ha ey hokwe, hakwe ya non-wawwaw onok a. Hakwe hme senkin lonseyn,

homkwe God so sipsip orhey non, hmo iha mon ma kow sohom mo naykih kwa lwak. Seyr homkwe hme ma me-sasay me peie meio, sawk kar ley yor nonaw kwa nak-meio, God hiy ma nan senkin. Homkwe mein-owon kraiar me peie nan koukou-ay o, sawk hmo uron mokwe, uwrsa me hiymon e kwa nan kraiay.
Homkwe uwrsa, hmo iha mon ma kow me, uwr seirpey se hieyn peie me-sasay meio o, sawk hmo yor mokwe, uwrsa sohom mo owhnan yaprue me hieyn kwa lwak.
Sawk Sipsip kowa-uwr mo Makwey-uwr hiy lousne ankin, homkwe king so makwey-kokway panpaniowni non me lonokyaw ey. Panpaniowni sohokwe liy lira por ha ley.
Seyr liy-liy-aw, uwr warkiayr homkwe uwr hakamay mo ouon mon kwa lwak. Hom lowpwarowp kokwe, uwr uru lopa me hieyn hmo wayh-wayh me kwa hiymon. Payhokuaw, God so mamey porih hokwe mo senkin me,

content.text: “God hiykwe uwrsa ma aryar mokwe, me-puar. Sawk hyo maym mokwe, uwrsa uru lopa me hieyn ma lanio me kow.”

content: Homkwe uwrsa, uru lopa me hieyn, God so iha seirpey-ar ko ouon mon kwa lwak, God hiy hme omok lowk nakie ey hokwe, enekwei yaprue God hiykiaw ma nan sok.
Hom pay me lowk kworpakwor kawk e, hye nian-aw kwa mekow, payhokuaw, hiykwe hme hiy-mon wayr.
Homkwe homkiaw-ayay kwa lanok anok, seyr iray-iray nonaw kwa lwak. Hmo awia-pow hiykwe laion se hieyn inakok lawor-yay saw anio ira, uwr hiy lokwan-kwor ei-a ey se.

Homkwe hmo nan kiykiy-ay yor mon-aw kwa lorok kraiay, seyr Satan se kwa me-puar ono huon. Payhokuaw, homkwe nonkway, hmo kristen-wayh, kipay lowpwarowp ko homkwe low hom ma lway senkin liy-liy-aw lway.

Sawk enekwei haraw hom low ma lway so meyki hokwe, maym lowpwarowp mo God, hom Krais se nion ma non-okin nasay se hokuaw, hme hyo lwayr peyow panpaniowni se lonok e ma me-huonokyaw hiykwe, hme mon ihey ey, seyr hme krai o, lorok kraiay yor o, wei-a-wei yor lopa o, seme kow ey.
Krai lowpwarowp mokwe hyo mon-aw ka lwak peyow peyow. Okar.

Mamey haraw-ney okukwe, hanekwe Sailas hiy hiy-mey. Hakwe hye kokwe, kristen-wayh hane nion ma non-orok kraipakrai wayr se hieyn lira. Hakwe hme seme mey kow ha, hme me-kraipakrai e, seyr hme senkin me-kumay kow e, ok okukwe God so maym okar-ar hok non. Homkwe serey mon-aw kwa lorok kraipakrai.
God hiy hme nion ma lahan iaup homkwe, hmo me-ihey-ok mokwe hme mekow ha. Hano ney Mak seyn, liy-liy-aw mekow ha.
Homkwe hmo kristen-wayh me me-ihey-ok me ankin, homkwe uron-pi ko-ar yor nonaw kwa way neyr-a-neyr. Liwak-marowhway yor kokwe hom lowpwarowp Krais so mon ma lwak me nion ka non-wak.

footnotes.text: Uru sohokwe Mesair Hrahra ha Ok ko Mamey mon nak-wak, sa nonkway-uwr homkwe senkin nan, yier Rom se memeir.
